drawings.description: en marge gauche, au bas de la page, une figure : du point $u$, l'arc de grand cercle vers $x(u,v;\alpha)$ et celui vers $x(u,v';\alpha)$, l'angle $\theta$ entre eux marqué près de $u$ ; un trait épais joint $u$ au centre, d'où partent en tirets les rayons vers les deux points $x$, l'angle $\alpha$ marqué près du centre ; en bas, les vecteurs $v$, $v'$, $w$ issus du centre, un arc passant par leurs extrémités et l'angle $\theta$ entre $v$ et $v'$.
drawings.kind: spherical triangle from u with the vectors v, v', w
drawings.notes: Small ink figure in the left margin. From the point u, two arcs, to x(u,v;alpha) above and to x(u,v';alpha) at the left, both ending at the one point u; a small arc between them near u and the letter theta; a heavy stroke from u down to the centre; from the centre, dash-dotted radii to the two points x; alpha written near the centre, with two small arcs there. Below: three strokes from the centre to v, v' and w (arrowheads at v and w), an arc through the three ends, theta between v and v' with its small arc. All strokes from the centre start at one computed point. Still differs: the small arcs marking alpha are a reading of a few crowded strokes (he hatches a small fan there); the dash-dotted radius to x(u,v;alpha) is visible only in its upper part on the page and is drawn whole. The transcription's note has theta « près des sommets »: one theta near u and one below between v and v' are seen. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, un cercle sans légende, partagé par des rayons issus d'un point voisin du centre : cinq rayons à peu près également espacés (celui du haut à gauche court et pâle, celui du bas à gauche épais et dépassant le cercle, celui du bas à droite n'atteignant pas le cercle) et un sixième trait, horizontal, vers la gauche ; deux points du bord marqués d'un petit trait, à gauche ; un arc double entre les deux rayons de droite.
drawings.kind: circle divided by radii (division in five)
drawings.notes: A circle (ellipse fitted to his outline, which is open at the upper left) and the strokes from one inner point, slightly left of and below the centre: towards the top (to the outline), to the right (to the outline), to the lower right (stops short of the outline), to the lower left (heavy, overshoots the outline, where a small cross marks the point), to the upper left (short and faint, stops well short), and a sixth, horizontal, to the left as far as the outline. Two points of the outline are marked by a short stroke: at the upper left (a tick with a bar) and at the lower left (the cross). Between the right-hand radius and the lower right one, the outline is doubled by two inner arcs. Disagreement in part with the transcription's note (« partagé par cinq rayons »): six strokes leave the centre; five of them are spaced by about 72 degrees, the sixth (horizontal, to the left) is extra. Still differs: the outline is an ellipse; the doubled arc is approximate. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, un grand cercle tracé à la main, vide, avec « $\varphi(n)$ » écrit contre son bord droit.
drawings.kind: large hand-drawn circle, labelled at its right
drawings.notes: A large free-hand circle, empty, redrawn as a closed curve through points read on his outline, with phi(n) written against its right side, lower than the middle, as on the page. Small irregularities of the stroke (a notch at the upper right, a doubled bit at the bottom where it closes) are not reproduced. The two oblique strokes that the transcription's note mentions join mu_n^* to S in the formulas at the right; they belong to that small diagram, not to the circle, and are not drawn. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: feuillet de carnet à spirale, en largeur, couvert d'une trentaine de croquis à l'encre et au crayon, mêlés de formules : fleurs à trois, quatre ou cinq pétales, dont l'une, en marge gauche, est légendée « corolle », « racine », « tige », « cœur », « pétale » ; une fleur à trois lobes à côté d'un disque noirci ; tétraèdres et pyramides, dont l'un, au crayon, avec un point intérieur relié aux sommets ; un losange à diagonales suivi d'un « $G$ » ; un hexagone découpé en six triangles, relié par un arc à un point près du « $G$ » et légendé « $\mathrm{O}(3)$ », « $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ » ; une suite de trois ovales emboîtés dont le plus intérieur porte « $u_1$ » et « $u_0$ » cerclé ; un carré inscrit dans un quadrilatère, reliés par les diagonales ; un graphe en forme de cube aplati, à sommets marqués de ronds, de croix et de points ; un cube dont trois faces sont fléchées vers un sommet ; un gros « 8 ».
drawings.kind: notebook leaf covered with sketches (flowers, polyhedra, nested ovals)
drawings.notes: Whole leaf, about thirty small sketches in ink and pencil among formulas; only a selection is redrawn, each at its place on the leaf (1 unit = 1.8 mm): the flower of the left margin with its legends (heart, two petals, stem ending in a dot, the oval of the root; the words corolle, racine, tige, cœur, pétale written along the margin); the four-petalled flower with its stalk; the three-lobed flower (three closed lobes from one centre point) and the blackened disc beside it (hatched); the three nested ovals with u_1 and the circled u_0; the square inside a quadrilateral, corners joined; the hexagon cut into six triangles from its centre, the arc from it to the dot near « G », and « O(3) », « SO(3) »; the large pencil tetrahedron with an inner point joined to its three vertices; the heavy « 8 ». NOT redrawn: the small tetrahedra and pyramids of the top row and of the bottom row, the rhombus with diagonals, the leaf-shaped and lens-shaped outlines, the faint pencil circles, the two five-petalled flowers at the right, the two touching discs, the graph with marked vertices, the cube with arrows, the heavy quadrilateral figures at the top right and bottom right, the chain 4 -> 3 -> 2 -> 1 -> 0 and all the formulas (which the transcription gives). Disagreements with the transcription's note: the nested ovals are three (it says « une suite d'ovales emboîtés dont les deux plus intérieurs portent u_1 et u_0 »: both letters are inside the innermost oval); the graph it calls « sur six sommets » seems to have eight vertices (a square inside a square, corners joined), to be checked. Still differs: everything listed as not redrawn; the lobes and petals are smooth curves through a few read points. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au centre, la projection de l'icosaèdre sur le plan orthogonal à un axe : un décagone inscrit dans un cercle au crayon, dont les sommets portent, dans le sens des aiguilles d'une montre à partir du haut à gauche, $A_1, A'_3, A_0, A'_2, A_4, A'_1, A_3, A'_0, A_2, A'_4$ (plusieurs lettres récrites, $A$ par-dessus $\alpha$ ; $\alpha_0$ est resté tel) ; le centre marqué $s'$ et $s$ ; les deux pentagones $A_i$ et $A'_i$ tracés, celui des $A_i$ avec le côté $A_0A_4$ très appuyé, et les dix rayons, celui de $A_2$ appuyé, celui de $A'_2$ en pointillé, celui de $A'_4$ en tirets.
drawings.kind: projection of the icosahedron: decagon with two pentagons and radii
drawings.notes: Ten vertices read on his figure (it is not quite regular) and every edge drawn between these same ten points and the one centre: the ten sides of the decagon (heavy: A_1 A'_3, A'_1 A_3, A_2 A'_0), the pentagon A_1 A_0 A_4 A_3 A_2 (its side A_0 A_4 very heavy), the pentagon A'_3 A'_2 A'_1 A'_0 A'_4 (faint; the side A'_0 A'_4 broken), the ten radii (to A_2 heavy, to A'_2 dotted, to A'_4 dashed, to A'_3 and A'_1 faint), the pencil circle around, the centre marked s' (above) and s (below). Labels outside the vertices, as on the page; the letter at the upper right is his alpha_0, not rewritten into A_0. DISAGREEMENT with the transcription's note, which gives the cyclic order A_1, A'_3, A_0, A'_2, A_4, A'_1, A_2, A'_0, A_3, A'_4: on the page the vertex at the bottom is A_3 and the vertex at the left is A_2 (so that both pentagons run with indices decreasing by one clockwise); the mark gives the order of the page. Still differs: line weights are a reading of pencil strokes gone over several times; the overwritten primes and indices of A'_1 and A'_4 (a 1 and a 4 written one over the other at the lower right; a 2 and a 4 at the upper left) are read with the help of the cyclic order. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.disagreement: The note of the transcription gives the vertices in the order A_1, A'_3, A_0, A'_2, A_4, A'_1, A_2, A'_0, A_3, A'_4; on the page the bottom vertex reads A_3 and the left one A_2: A_1, A'_3, A_0, A'_2, A_4, A'_1, A_3, A'_0, A_2, A'_4.

drawings.description: plus bas à droite, sous les formules, un petit ovale au crayon et à l'encre : un trait horizontal épais le traverse, un trait vertical fin le coupe, et du milieu partent deux traits épais vers le haut à gauche et vers le haut à droite ; un court trait horizontal au-dessus.
drawings.notes: A small oval (ellipse fitted to his outline) crossed by a heavy horizontal stroke whose ends are computed on the outline, and by a thin vertical stroke; from the crossing, two heavy strokes to the upper left and to the upper right; a short horizontal stroke above them and a small tick at the upper left. Not mentioned in the transcription. Still differs: the meaning of the figure is not known and the strokes are placed by eye; the vertical stroke stops short of the outline at both ends, as on the page. On the same leaf, at the right of the decagon, a faint pencil sketch (a point with strokes to the upper left, heavy, to the upper right and, dashed, to the right, over a thin triangle and a heavy base line, with overwritten letters) is not marked and not drawn. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: croquis en marge gauche, rattaché à « NB » par un trait : deux flèches parallèles $G_\rho \rightrightarrows G_\rho$ marquées $\bar f, \bar g$, une flèche montante de $\pi_1(X)$ vers le premier $G_\rho$, et une courbe sans tête de $\pi_1(X)$ au second
drawings.notes: Two parallel arrows G_rho => G_rho marked bar f, bar g, an arrow going up from pi_1(X) to the first G_rho, and a headless curve from pi_1(X) to the second. The stroke tying the sketch to « NB » passes through the crop (vertical stroke above the second G_rho, horizontal stroke to its right); only its part inside the crop is drawn, in pencil. The bars of bar f and bar g are written as two short strokes above the letters.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, un icosaèdre dessiné en perspective : un contour hexagonal, quatre sommets intérieurs et les arêtes qui les joignent, quelques arêtes cachées en tirets.
drawings.notes: Small ink sketch of an icosahedron seen in perspective. Six vertices on the outline (a hexagon, its two upper right sides heavy) and four inside; every edge is drawn between these ten points: from the upper inner vertex to the three upper outline vertices, to the left outline vertex and to the central vertex; from the left outline vertex through the left inner vertex to the central vertex; from the left inner vertex up to the upper left vertex and down to the bottom vertex; from the central vertex to the right, lower right and bottom outline vertices; a fourth inner vertex at the right, joined by broken strokes to the upper right and lower right vertices and by a heavy stroke to the right vertex (hidden edges). 23 edges are drawn here; an icosahedron seen so shows more, and the page is too small and too heavily inked to tell every edge apart. Still differs: which strokes are edges is a reading; the bottom vertex is drawn double on the page (two close points) and single here. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: plus bas dans la marge, un cercle traversé d'un faisceau de traits presque confondus, à peu près verticaux, issus d'un même point du haut du cercle, et d'un trait oblique double qui les croise ; le haut du cercle est doublé d'un second arc à droite.
drawings.kind: circle crossed by nearly coincident strokes
drawings.notes: A free-hand circle (closed curve through points of his outline), doubled at the upper right by a second arc. From the top of the circle, a bundle of strokes going down through one crossing point: a long one that ends heavy low in the circle, a second ending in a small dot, and two short heavy strokes above the crossing; across them, through the same point, an oblique double stroke from the upper right to the lower left, heavy at its lower end. At the bottom, the stroke that comes up from the next figure (its prolonged diameter) reaches the outline. The transcription's note says « deux diamètres presque confondus »: the bundle is of three or four strokes, and the oblique stroke is separate. Still differs: the strokes of the bundle are drawn through one point, whereas on the page they cross within a millimetre of each other; none is exactly a diameter. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: plus bas encore, un cercle avec un diamètre prolongé hors du cercle des deux côtés (vers le haut jusqu'au cercle précédent), une corde horizontale qui le coupe en un point marqué, et deux points marqués sur le bord, en haut ; à gauche, un arc intérieur descend du point marqué de gauche.
drawings.kind: circle with a prolonged diameter and marked points
drawings.notes: A circle (ellipse fitted to his outline); a straight stroke through it, prolonged beyond the circle at both ends (upwards to the figure above, downwards to a small dot), passing through a marked point of the outline at the upper right and a marked point inside; a horizontal chord through that inner point, its ends computed on the outline; a second marked point on the outline at the upper left, from which an inner arc runs down the left side to the lower crossing; a short arc at the bottom left. Still differs: the inner arcs are approximate; the prolonged stroke is not exactly a diameter (the marked inner point is slightly off the centre). Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: sous « $\frac12 B = B'$ », trois segments issus d'un même point : deux épais, terminés par un point, et un fin entre eux.
drawings.notes: Three strokes from one point at the bottom left: a heavy one going up, slightly to the left, ending in a dot; a thin one going up to the right; a heavy one going to the right, less steeply, ending in a dot. All three start at the same computed point. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, un grand croquis : une grande courbe fermée contenant un disque (avec un trait intérieur, comme un rayon), un second domaine arrondi accolé au premier par-dessous et à droite, une boucle en pétale attachée à ce second domaine, une petite figure ramifiée (une tige double portant des branches en doigts) attachée au premier disque, et, à part, un court trait oblique.
drawings.kind: closed curve containing two adjoining discs, a loop and a branched figure
drawings.notes: Ink sketch. A large closed curve (through points read on his outline). Inside: a disc at the left (a circle), with an inner stroke like a radius; a second rounded domain adjoining it below and to the right, drawn as a curve that leaves the first disc at its upper right, makes a corner and returns to the foot of the first disc (both ends computed on the circle); a petal-shaped loop attached to the second domain at its upper right; a branched figure attached to the first disc at its upper right: a double stem and an outline with finger-like branches, two short strokes inside; a short arc above the disc running into the stem; apart, at the upper right, a short oblique stroke, heavy at its upper end. Still differs: the branched figure is a reading of a small crowded outline (the number and shape of its fingers, three or four, are approximate). The transcription's note says « deux disques accolés »: the second is not a full circle but a domain bounded in part by the first disc. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: plus bas, un anneau : une grande courbe presque fermée (ouverte à gauche) entourant un ovale, avec une petite boucle attachée au bord intérieur, qui monte jusqu'à la courbe extérieure.
drawings.kind: annulus with a small loop on its inner boundary
drawings.notes: The outer curve, drawn in one stroke from a small hook at the left, over the top, round the right and back along the bottom, not closed at the left; the inner oval (an ellipse fitted to it); a small loop standing on the inner oval at its upper right (starting and ending at one computed point of the oval) and reaching the outer curve. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en marge gauche, au milieu de la note oblique, un autre anneau : deux cercles emboîtés ; le disque intérieur porte \uncertain{« dans le »}.
drawings.kind: annulus in the margin (two nested circles)
drawings.notes: Two nested closed curves, drawn as ellipses fitted to his outlines. The words of the marginal note run obliquely across the ring and the inner disc; they are text and are not redrawn, including the doubtful « dans le » that the transcription reads in the inner disc. Still differs: the outlines are ellipses; nothing else is on the figure. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.
